typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		Date as date,
		Transformer as string,
		UPS as string,
		DG as string,
		HVAC as string,
		{Access (as per Biometric, Panel and Server)} as string,
		{Fire Alarm System} as string,
		BMS as string,
		Remark as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FName = $FileName,
		UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		EtlUser = $userName,
		Transformer1 = toInteger(replace(Transformer, toString('%'), toString(''))) / 100,
		DG1 = toInteger(replace(DG, toString('%'), toString(''))) / 100,
		UPS1 = toInteger(replace(UPS, toString('%'), toString(''))) / 100,
		HVAC1 = toInteger(replace(HVAC, toString('%'), toString(''))) / 100,
		Access1 = toInteger(replace({Access (as per Biometric, Panel and Server)}, toString('%'), toString(''))) / 100,
		FireAlarmSystem1 = toInteger(replace({Fire Alarm System}, toString('%'), toString(''))) / 100,
		BMS1 = toInteger(replace(BMS, toString('%'), toString(''))) / 100) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		UploadDate as string,
		EtlUser as string,
		HVAC as double,
		Transformer as double,
		DG as double,
		FireAlarmSystem as double,
		Access as double,
		UPS as double,
		BMS as double,
		FName as string,
		Date as string,
		Remark as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		UploadDate,
		EtlUser,
		HVAC = HVAC1,
		Transformer = Transformer1,
		DG = DG1,
		FireAlarmSystem = FireAlarmSystem1,
		Access = Access1,
		UPS = UPS1,
		BMS = BMS1,
		FName,
		Date,
		Remark),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
